say:3:1520548001:1.source_cn: 摩根，你魔力使用过度了。

say:4:1520548002:0.text: I think we could have ended the ritual earlier. Even a brief moment with their lost loved ones is more than enough to comfort the living.
say:4:1520548002:0.source_cn: 祭祀仪式其实早就可以结束，不是吗？那些悲痛的生者已经见...

say:5:1520548003:0.text: *Cough* What else could I do? They just kept blabbering on and on.
say:5:1520548003:0.source_cn: 咳……谁让他们话那么多，说个没完。

say:6:1520548004:0.text: Have those souls returned to the forest?
say:6:1520548004:0.source_cn: 那些灵魂，他们回归丛林了吗？

say:7:1520548005:0.text: They have. Morgan's magic only brought them back to the mortal world temporarily. After this, they'll journey to the Tree of Life and return to the world in forms that are still unknown to us...
say:7:1520548005:0.source_cn: 是的。摩根的魔法只会暂时将他们唤回现世，之后，他们仍会...

say:8:1520548006:0.text: In this way, their souls will find rest, and the Wildborn have spoken their final words to their loved ones, as dictated by your traditions.
say:8:1520548006:0.source_cn: 所以，他们将会得到安眠。而你的族人也依循传统，向所爱之...

say:9:1520548007:0.text: Isn't this a happy ending for everyone?
say:9:1520548007:0.source_cn: 皆大欢喜的结局，不是吗？

say:11:1520548009:0.text: The thing is, I haven't fully perfected this magic. Even with your help, I could only summon the souls for a fleeting moment.
say:11:1520548009:0.source_cn: 这种魔法的理论还不完善，即便借助你们的魔力，也只能召唤...

say:12:1520548010:0.text: You're still not giving up on the resurrection magic, huh?
say:12:1520548010:0.source_cn: 你还在想让人死而复生的魔法？<key:dialog1>

say:13:1520548011:0.text: I want to challenge the God of Death.

choice_prompt:14:1520548011.text: I want to challenge the God of Death.

say:15:1520548012:0.text: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.
say:15:1520548012:0.source_cn: 对能弑神的人而言，这还不够谦虚吗？<key:dialog1>
say:15:1520548012:0.male: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.
say:15:1520548012:0.female: I'm no match for you in this aspect, god slayer.

say:16:1520548014:0.text: *Cough* If you happen to meet the God of Death before Merlin and I do, send him a word for me. No offense, but for some reason, you seem especially prone to bad luck.
say:16:1520548014:0.source_cn: 咳……不是诅咒你。只是觉得你在倒霉这件事上特别有天赋—...
say:16:1520548014:0.male: *Cough* If you happen to meet the God of Death before Merlin and I do, send him a word for me. No offense, but for some reason, you seem especially prone to bad luck.
say:16:1520548014:0.female: *Cough* If you happen to meet the God of Death before Merlin and I do, send him a word for me. No offense, but for some reason, you seem especially prone to bad luck.

say:17:1520548015:0.text: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!
say:17:1520548015:0.source_cn: 告诉他，他是个混蛋。请他快点神堕，我等不及敲着他的头骨...
say:17:1520548015:0.male: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!
say:17:1520548015:0.female: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!

choice_prompt:18:1520548015.text: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!
choice_prompt:18:1520548015.source_cn: 告诉他，他是个混蛋。请他快点神堕，我等不及敲着他的头骨唱圣歌。
choice_prompt:18:1520548015.male: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!
choice_prompt:18:1520548015.female: Tell him he's a scumbag, and I can't wait for his fall!

say:20:1520548017:1.text: Let's go, Merlin. We've done our part.
say:20:1520548017:1.source_cn: 走吧，梅林。这地方已经不需要我们了。

say:21:1520548018:1.text: By the way, keep me off all work for the coming week.
say:21:1520548018:1.source_cn: 对了，未来一周，什么活都不要给我。

say:22:1520548019:1.text: Heh, unless there's an emergency, of course.
say:22:1520548019:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵……当然，除非紧急情况。

say:24:1520548021:1.text: I hate it when people thank me. Spare me, little one.
say:24:1520548021:1.source_cn: 道谢会伤人。免了吧，小家伙。

narration:25:1520548022:0.text: Morgan and Merlin leave, their shadows stretching out beneath the sunset.
narration:25:1520548022:0.source_cn: 摩根和梅林拖着夕阳下的影子离开了

narration:26:1520548023:0.text: But the Wildborn you helped still remain.
narration:26:1520548023:0.source_cn: 但是，你们所帮助的人，还没有散去

narration:27:1520548024:0.text: They whisper to the trees, the breeze, and the dewdrops slipping from the leaves in the forest.
narration:27:1520548024:0.source_cn: 他们仍然留在原地，对丛林，对风，对叶尖坠落的露水说话

choice:18:1:2.text: That's it? I can do better.
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 你好没创意，我会添油加醋的
choice:18:1:2.male: That's it? I can do better.
choice:18:1:2.female: That's it? I can do better.

choice:18:2:3.text: Tell him to his face yourself!
choice:18:2:3.male: Tell him to his face yourself!
choice:18:2:3.female: Tell him to his face yourself!

choice:14:1:2.text: I'm not a fan of him either!
choice:14:1:2.male: I'm not a fan of him either!
choice:14:1:2.female: I'm not a fan of him either!

say:29:1520548013:1.text: I almost wish I were naive enough to buy that.
say:29:1520548013:1.source_cn: 你说得这么认真，我差点就信了——如果我没长耳朵的话。<...
say:29:1520548013:1.male: I almost wish I were naive enough to buy that.
say:29:1520548013:1.female: I almost wish I were naive enough to buy that.
